title: SG-2.6 · Create the asset files that manifest.json references
summary: Every path in the-boys-room manifest.json resolves to a real file under game/public/assets
description: Context: game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json lists ten the-boys-room assets (backgrounds/bedroom-room.svg, furniture/bed.svg, bookshelf.svg, desk.svg, objects/old-computer.svg, window.svg, door.svg, characters/boy-sheet.svg, effects/dust.svg, audio/ambient-room.wav). Today only manifest.json lives under game/public; the files exist solely under game/frontend/public/assets. Desired behavior: the ten files exist under game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room. Expected result: every manifest path resolves to a real file. Why: the asset architecture keeps content under game/public/assets and the loader must not report missing assets.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/public/assets as the root, When each of the ten listed manifest paths is resolved, Then a non-empty file exists
Given the manifest, When parseManifest runs, Then it still returns ok
Given the files, When inspected, Then each SVG is well-formed and the WAV has a RIFF/WAVE header
technical_constraints: Temporary pixel-art SVGs with shape-rendering crispEdges
definition_of_done: All ten files exist at the manifest paths
